faq.q: Is German B2 enough to study at a university in Germany?
faq.a: It depends on the university and the programme. Many German-taught programmes ask for B2 or C1 proof. Check the admissions page of your target university for the level and the certificates it accepts.

faq.q: What does the Goethe-Zertifikat B2 exam include?
faq.a: The Goethe B2 exam is modular: Lesen, Hören, Schreiben and Sprechen. It tests complex texts, lectures and discussions, formal writing and arguing a position. Our B2 course in Dehradun trains each module with mock tests.

faq.q: What changes between German B1 and B2?
faq.a: At B2 you move from handling situations to arguing, explaining and writing in a formal register, with more advanced grammar such as the full passive, Konjunktiv I and II and nominalisation.

faq.q: Can I prepare for German B2 while working in Dehradun?
faq.a: Yes. We offer evening batches, online classes and personalised sessions, so working professionals can prepare for the Goethe B2 exam alongside their job.

faq.q: Do you help students from Dehradun plan their study in Germany?
faq.a: Our counsellors help you plan your German levels backwards from your university intake, including time for the Goethe exam and results.
